text:
anya: FYI I noticed our JS SDK silently drops `max_batch_size` when callers pass `batchingHint` (camelCase) -> REST expects `max_batch_size` or `batching_hint`. throughput regressed on the sample app after yesterday's downstream change. :frowning_face:
sam: can you paste a tiny repro?
anya: short curl vs sdk below. REST honors larger batch; SDK falls back to default 8.
anya: ```bash
# REST (works, respects max_batch_size)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-xxl","batching_hint":0.9,"max_batch_size":64,"inputs":["x","y","z"]}'

# JS SDK (silently sends default max_batch_size)
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const c = new Redwood({ token: process.env.TOKEN });
await c.generate({ model: 'redwood-xxl', inputs: ['x','y','z'], batchingHint: 0.9, maxBatchSize: 64 });
```
qa-bot: quick check: logs show payload normalized to `{max_batch_size:8}` for that request id 01GHIJKL5678.
anya: exact. interestingly, if the SDK receives a 401 the sampleapp retries, but our control plane sometimes returns 403 for ephemeral-refresh race which the SDK treats as non-retryable -> app-level retry happens and you can get duplicate side effects (webhook calls). filed a brief note in the ticket.
sam: two issues then: (1) param name/normalization parity across JS/Python/Go SDKs; (2) ambiguous retry behavior for 401 vs 403 with ephemeral token refresh.
anya: created DEVEX-8002 with traces and minimal repro, attaching logs and the sampleapp run.
qa-bot: suggested mitigation: SDK should warn when unknown fields are dropped in dev mode, and provide a `strict: true` flag to error on unknown fields.
sam: plan: I'll add a small shim to accept camelCase aliases (batchingHint -> batching_hint -> max_batch_size) with a console.warn in dev and a unit+integration test comparing SDK request payload to direct REST. also add a test for 403 vs 401 retry semantics in the sampleapp harness.
anya: perfect. please include guidance in the sampleapp README so customers don't accidentally trigger duplicates when they do unconditional retries.
devex-bot: Created task DEVEX-12456 from this thread and assigned to @sam.
sam: thanks — PR soon. also will open a follow-up to discuss canonical param naming for our public API surface.
anya: long-term: consider generating SDK input validators from the API spec so naming drift gets flagged during CI.
sam: +1. adding to the SDK roadmap epic. :rocket:
